question: How many casual leaves do employees get per year?
ground_truth_answer: Employees are entitled to 12 casual leaves per year.
ground_truth_contexts: Employees are entitled to 12 casual leaves per year and 10 sick leaves per year.

question: How many days per week can employees work from home?
ground_truth_answer: Employees may work from home up to 2 days per week with manager approval.
ground_truth_contexts: Employees may work from home up to 2 days per week with prior approval from their reporting manager.

question: Within how many days must an expense claim be submitted?
ground_truth_answer: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense.
ground_truth_contexts: All claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense, along with valid receipts, through the expense management system.

question: Above what amount does an expense claim require manager approval?
ground_truth_answer: Claims above 5000 rupees require manager approval.
ground_truth_contexts: Claims above 5000 rupees require manager approval before submission.

question: When are new employees issued a laptop?
ground_truth_answer: New employees are issued a laptop within their first week of joining.
ground_truth_contexts: New employees are issued a laptop and standard peripherals within their first week of joining.

question: What should an employee do if they experience harassment at work?
ground_truth_answer: It should be reported to HR immediately.
ground_truth_contexts: Harassment, discrimination, or any form of misconduct will not be tolerated and should be reported to HR immediately.
